title: Save File Envelope
description: Top-level envelope for save files. Contains versioning, integrity checksum, timestamp, and the serialized player data payload.

version.description: Save format version number. Incremented when the data schema changes, used by SaveMigrator to apply migrations.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when the save was created.

checksum.description: Integrity checksum of the serialized data payload. Algorithm is implementation-defined (e.g. SHA-256, CRC32).

data.description: The serialized player state. Keys are section names, values are section data dictionaries.
